releases.name: Omena Rust crate train, CLI, and npm bindings 0.5.0
distribution: The coordinated train contains 51 publishable Rust crates at exact version `0.5.0`, including the first publication of `omena-reactive`.
The GitHub Release contains five native `omena-cli` archives and their SHA-256 checksums for version `0.5.0`.
Selected npm publication stages `@omena/wasm`, `@omena/napi`, its native target packages, and build-tool integrations at `0.5.0` from the Rust workspace version.

releases.name: Omena CSS Modules 5.4.0
distribution: The GitHub Release contains the `5.4.0` VSIX, SBOM, and build-provenance attestation from one immutable commit.
The extension packages the validated Rust language server, engine shadow runner, and TypeScript backend matrix from that same commit.
Marketplace and Open VSX publication remain independently verified channels even when they consume the same VSIX.
